k_psi.method: 3-D magnetostatic Stage A (I = 0) at this machine's own stack: k_flux_self (axial mean of the gap fundamental / its own mid-plane value, the pure end effect) — the run's 2-D check FAILED (3-D mid-plane / 2-D = 0.9547, tolerance 2 %), so k_flux = 0.9217 is not used, as the run itself instructs

k_T.method: k_T = k_ψ (Stage A, this run): the app's own 3-D torque rule (end3d_k on every duty); no loaded 3-D torque run (Stage B/D) for this die — on the Ø40 the loaded k_T was 0.979 vs k_ψ 0.947, so this is likely CONSERVATIVE by up to ~(1−k_ψ)·0.6

k_L.method: not computed: no Stage B long-stack test for this die; Ld/Lq are 2-D (no end-winding inductance)

magnet_segmentation.note: magnets are one axial piece; rotor/magnet eddy loss is a 2-D (infinitely long, no axial return path) value — an axially unsegmented magnet of length L carries its eddy current along L and returns at the ends, so the 2-D value is an UPPER bound; segmentation is not modelled

demag_limit.rule: highest overload current after which the rated-point torque drops <= 1 % (owner default 2, default pending owner)
demag_limit.how: not defined at this HOT reference: the rated point itself loses 14.7 % of its torque to demagnetisation from virgin magnets (demag share 0.853), so the rule's reference is already damaged; overloads up to the probes left the rated torque within -1.86, -1.79 % of that damaged value. The safe current at this magnet temperature is below 0.25·I0 (Br-retention knee 1.4 A).
demag_limit.method: overload on the hot MTPA line at rated speed (TDM + demag pre-pass), then the rated point with the Br ratchet continued (solver sweep seed); retention = Br-volume kept on the hot MTPA line (stage-1 probes)

cooling.method: coupled EM-thermal loop (routes.coupled.run, TDM eddy + demag, the duty's mesh) per cooling option; S1 = coupled_continuous_rating (network fitted to the 2-D thermal map, re-solved until s* settles, verified by an EM pass at I_cont); limits = time from cold to the first part limit; part limits from the machine's cards (winding: the loop's class-N 200 °C assumption; magnet: card max working temperature; housing: the loop's touch limit)
labels: propeller slipstream factor 0.4 (behind hub) — to be calibrated

lumped.method: Configure's lumped model (web/src/lib/thermalEstimate.ts, ported): lateral housing + both end faces at one film; robotics film = still air + radiation (outer_still, eps 0.9) at the housing temperature, NO mount / heat path; propeller film = cross-flow at the slipstream (outer_air); losses = the passport trajectory (copper at its own temperature); torque = hot map × k_state × k_T

propeller_match.n_cont_basis: highest speed where the prop torque ≤ the propeller-air S1 card torque (S1 at 1000/1500/2000 rpm, linear between; none below the first S1 speed means the prop is lighter than S1 there)

envelope_card.method: hot psi-map, I ≤ I_peak (peak curve) / I = I0 (rated-current curve), V ≤ m·V_dc/√3 with ψ×k_psi(3-D) (applied as V_lim/k_psi); torque = map × k_state × k_T

efficiency_map.method: loss trajectory (m 0.89) interpolation + analytic mech, torque map × k_state × k_T; characterised region only (grid speeds × 0.5·I0…I_peak); sine drive
